data.effects:
It's difficult to evaluate Basti's resume. In the eyes of those in power, it's a criminal record; in the eyes of local factions, it's a threatening letter; but in the Commander's eyes, it's a moving love letter.
"Darling, want to know my secrets? The way things are now isn't enough—you need to be bolder, even bolder—"

effectDetails.mainDetails:
Considered a summoned unit. Inherits Basti’s initial stats.

When it is spawned, if there is an enemy unit within 3 tiles of this summoned unit, or if an enemy unit, while within that range, is spawned, ends it turn, or is passively displaced, it self-destructs, dealing AoE Corrosion damage to all enemy units within that range equal to 100% of attack and 2 points of stability damage, as well as generating [effect:1c5e2242-b8ce-41b6-934a-5779d82f6790] tiles for 2 turns.

In addition, it applies [effect:58510661-8f45-4d0e-8a2b-3d31357deccf] and [effect:dd0752a2-37c4-47ba-91ad-2dc640d2372b] to enemy units within the area for 2 turns. It also restores HP equal to 80% of attack and 1 point of stability to Basti.

Up to 2 such summoned units can exist on the battlefield at once.
